narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think the pinwheel has lines of symmetry because it looks balanced.
<bookmark mark='fold'/>Fold the pinwheel along any line you like. Its twisted vanes never land on each other.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Looking balanced is not the test, because only matching halves after a fold count.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, fold along each line you counted and see if the halves overlap exactly.
<bookmark mark='all'/>If even one part sticks out, that fold line does not count as a line of symmetry.
